comments.author: Wrath_Jr
comments.body_html:
Im interested in using your mod but I have a question

Is it possible to use the quest generation functionality but without using the quest shuffle functionality ? Like all the vanilla quest remain the same, but the mod keeps adding more ?

comments.author: cccpvs
comments.body_html:
Hi, yes you can try that. Here is an example config for Config.json

"TargetTraderIds": [],
"QuestTypes": [],
"RemoveStandartQuests": false,
"RemoveStartConditionsQuest": false,
"RemoveFinishConditionTypes": [],
"GenerateRandomQuests": {
    "enable": true,
    "count": 30
},
"RandomQuests": {
    "count": 0,
}

Do not use the number of quests on locations in RandomQuests. Random quests will be created in addition to the standard ones.

comments.author: GSCGabeast
comments.body_html: how do you remove the original standard quest conditions and replace it with randomized quest objectives from your mod?

comments.author: cccpvs
comments.body_html:
In the “Config.json” file, use the following:

  1. “ModifyBaseQuest” = true

  2. “RemoveFinishConditionTypes” = [“FindItem”,“GlobalVariableValue”,“HandoverItem”,“HideoutArea”,“LeaveItemAtLocation”,“PlaceBeacon”,“Quest”,“SellItemToTrader”,“Skill”,“TraderLoyalty”,“TraderStanding”,“VisitPlace”,“WeaponAssembly”,“Completion”,“Discover”,“Elimination”,“Experience”,“Exploration”]

This mod removes all base quest conditions and adds new random tasks to the standard quest.
